mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_share (id, file_id, share_code, password, expire_at, download_limit, download_count, created_by, created_at) VALUES ( #{id}, #{fileId}, #{shareCode}, #{password}, #{expireAt}, #{downloadLimit}, #{downloadCount}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE file_share SET password = #{password}, expire_at = #{expireAt}, download_limit = #{downloadLimit}, download_count = #{downloadCount} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_id, share_code, password, expire_at, download_limit, download_count, created_by, created_at FROM file_share WHERE REPLACE(created_by, '-', '') = REPLACE(#{createdBy}, '-', '') ORDER BY created_at DESC
